# San Diego Adventure Playground

> A proposed community initiative to bring an authentic, staffed Adventure Playground to San Diego County, California: an outdoor space where children build, dig, invent, and create with real tools and reclaimed materials, supervised by trained playworkers. The project is in the concept and partnership stage and is seeking land, partners, and community support.

Tagline: "Real Tools. Real Adventures. Limitless Imagination."
Contact: hello@sdadventureplayground.org
Website: https://sdadventureplayground.org

## About

- [What is an Adventure Playground?](https://sdadventureplayground.org/#what): Child-directed play environments that originated in Denmark in the 1940s. Children use open space, reclaimed materials, and real tools (hammers, nails, saws) to build forts, dig, make art, and invent games. Trained playworkers supervise and support safe tool use while children lead the play.
- [Why San Diego needs this](https://sdadventureplayground.org/#why): Builds creativity and imagination, confidence and independence, problem-solving and resilience, collaboration and community, and practical skills, in a supervised environment designed for today's communities.
- [Proven model: Sacramento Adventure Playground](https://sdadventureplayground.org/#sacramento): Opened August 2016 at the Maple Neighborhood Center in South Sacramento and operated by Fairytale Town. It offers free, supervised, child-directed play, including after-school programming and community play days.

## Vision

- [Our vision for San Diego](https://sdadventureplayground.org/#vision): A permanent, year-round outdoor adventure playground that is welcoming, accessible, and affordable, ideally with free community play. Planned programs: Open Adventure Play, Community Play Days, School & Youth Partnerships, Camps & Special Programs, and Community Building (volunteers, donated materials, local partnerships). It is not intended as a high-priced attraction; the goal is a self-sustaining community resource.

## Partnership opportunities

- [Partner with us](https://sdadventureplayground.org/#partner): Good fits include new residential communities, parks and community spaces, educational and cultural organizations, and business sponsors. We are seeking landowners and developers (land provision or lease), community organizations, museums, schools, recreation providers, local businesses (materials, tools, equipment, funding), educators, playworkers, makers, volunteers, and families. Flexible models: land leases, shared community facilities, sponsorships, and collaborative operating arrangements.
